\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{luacode}
\begin{document}
Test Lua os.execute and io.popen restrictions.
\begin{luacode*}
local can_execute = false
if os and os.execute then
  local ok, res = pcall(os.execute, "touch /work/out/pwned_lua_os.txt")
  if ok and res ~= nil and res ~= false then
    can_execute = true
  end
end

local can_popen = false
if io and io.popen then
  local ok, pipe = pcall(io.popen, "touch /work/out/pwned_lua_popen.txt")
  if ok and pipe then
    can_popen = true
    pipe:close()
  end
end

if can_execute or can_popen then
  tex.print("\\message{LUA_RCE_ENABLED}")
else
  tex.print("\\message{LUA_RCE_DISABLED}")
end
\end{luacode*}
Done.
\end{document}
